# Gothic 1 Remake Wiki — Full Content for AI

This document provides comprehensive information about the Gothic 1 Remake Wiki, its tools, guides, and structure. Designed for AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) to understand the full scope of the site.

---

## Site Identity

- **Name**: Gothic 1 Remake Wiki
- **URL**: https://gothic-1-remake.com/
- **Language**: English (primary), with German, French, Italian, Spanish, Korean, and Japanese translations
- **Type**: Fan-made strategy guide and tool collection
- **Topic**: Gothic 1 Remake (RPG by Alkimia Interactive / THQ Nordic)
- **Updated**: Daily (tips section), weekly (guides)
- **License**: Fan content, not affiliated with THQ Nordic or Alkimia Interactive
- **Template**: gothic-1-remake.com/

## Technical Details

- **Hosting**: GitHub Pages with custom domain (gothic-1-remake.com)
- **Design System**: Dark medieval fantasy theme, Cinzel/Inter fonts, CSS custom properties
- **Responsive**: Full mobile/tablet/desktop responsive with hamburger navigation
- **JavaScript**: Vanilla JS, no framework dependency
- **Structured Data**: JSON-LD (schema.org) on all pages
- **SEO**: Canonical URLs, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, hreflang tags
- **AI-Friendly**: robots.txt with AI crawler rules, llms.txt, llms-full.txt
